description: This file defines an abstract interface class 'ISessionServerApp' for session server applications within the Rialto server manager component. It declares various pure virtual methods related to session management, configuration, and control, intended to be implemented by concrete classes.

classes.name: ISessionServerApp
classes.description: An interface class for session server applications, providing methods for launching, configuration, status checks, and control operations.

methods.name: isPreloaded
methods.description: Checks if the session server is preloaded.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the session server with application name, initial state, and app configuration.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the session server is connected.

methods.name: getSessionManagementSocketName
methods.description: Retrieves the socket name used for session management.

methods.name: getSessionManagementSocketPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves the permissions for the session management socket.

methods.name: getClientDisplayName
methods.description: Gets the display name of the client.

methods.name: getInitialState
methods.description: Returns the initial session server state.

methods.name: getAppManagementSocketName
methods.description: Returns the socket name for app management.

methods.name: getMaxPlaybackSessions
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of playback sessions.

methods.name: getMaxWebAudioPlayers
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of Web Audio players.
